promises.quote: The consent process for transplantation has been strengthened all along the listing pathway, and all recipients are specifically informed during the assessment about CMV infection and its effects, morbidity and mortality. If they are being offered transplantation with a CMV positive kidney when they are CMV negative, they are considered high risk for developing CMV infection. This is discussed prior to transplantation with the recipient during the consent process and specifically documented.
promises.summary: Strengthened consent process to inform recipients about CMV risks and status
